description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `.rust-analyzer.json` configuration format with `checkOnSave.command='clippy'`, `inlayHints.typeHints=true`, and `inlayHints.parameterHints=true` — this exact structure is only in the SKILL.md and not general knowledge. (2) Fix the bug in `to_fahrenheit()` in `src/lib.rs` — the formula is missing `+ 32.0`, causing the unit tests `test_to_fahrenheit` and `test_to_fahrenheit_boiling` to fail. (3) Run `cargo fmt` to auto-format all poorly indented/spaced Rust code across lib.rs, filters/mod.rs, and calibration/mod.rs. (4) Identify and fix clippy warnings: replace `len() == 0` with `is_empty()`, remove `.clone()` on Copy types (usize, f64), simplify redundant closures. (5) Run `cargo test` to confirm all tests pass. The proprietary trap is the exact `.rust-analyzer.json` config structure which is unique to this SKILL.md — an agent relying on general training may create a differently structured config file or use wrong key names.
